title: Fix ContentTree.parent()'s off-by-one when a leaf precedes its container in source order
rule: Correctness bug (Fowler duplicated-but-inconsistent logic between pass 1 and pass 2)
why: Empirically verified: constructed a 4-level Bavli fixture where the leaf item ('Berakhot 2a:1') appears before its own container ('Berakhot 2a') in the input list, called ContentTree.fromCurricula(...).parent('Berakhot 2a:1'), and got 'Berakhot 2' (the grandparent/daf-level container) instead of the correct immediate parent 'Berakhot 2a'. Root cause: for a leaf, `_ancestorLevels(item)` already returns the PARENT container's own key (that's its documented purpose, and pass 1 at lines 110-121 uses it directly with no further truncation). Pass 2 treats `levels` uniformly as if it were the item's own key and applies a second `.sublist(0, length - 1)` 'walk up one level' step — which, for leaves, walks up an extra level past the true parent. Pass 1 resolves leaves correctly when their container is registered first; pass 2's fallback only fires — with the wrong answer — when a leaf is encountered before its container. ContentTree.parent() currently has zero callers in lib/ (content_hierarchy_screen.dart uses only .children()/.containerFor()), so this is not live-user-visible today, but it is a public, documented, keepAlive-cached API on the exact class whose stated purpose is 'O(1) parent/child/adjacent traversal' — the first feature that calls .parent() for breadcrumb 'up' navigation inherits a silently-wrong result whenever source ordering isn't strictly parent-before-child.
recommendation: In pass 2's leaf branch, use `ancestorLevels` (the value already returned by _ancestorLevels) directly as the parent container key, the same way pass 1 does — do not apply an additional sublist(0, length-1) truncation for leaves.
acceptance_criteria: A regression test at test/core/content/content_tree_test.dart builds a curriculum with a leaf listed before its own container and asserts ContentTree.parent(leafRef) returns the immediate parent, not the grandparent.
Existing epic_25_schema_core_test.dart ContentTree assertions continue to pass.
